summary:
**Status: partial** — PR #3 merged; 0.0.1 release blocked at the `release.sh` local test gate (exact output below). No force-push, no tags, no releases created.

## What was done

**1. PR review + merge-with-reds comment** — `gh pr view 3` confirmed head `56321ad` (test-align) on `a035c27` (json_check fix), mergeable `MERGEABLE`/state `UNSTABLE`. Posted rationale comment (known reds + post-0.0.1 test-polish follow-up): https://github.com/kolisachint/inkuno/pull/3#issuecomment-6734221047

**2. Merged** — `gh pr merge 3 --repo kolisachint/inkuno --merge --admin` succeeded. Merge commit **`a92250e43189966b28bb95fb5d190b54fb33dead`**, merged 2026-11-09T06:59:20Z. Branch `agent/inkuno-0.0.1` kept for reference (still at `56321ad`); nothing deleted.

**3. Fresh release checkout** — full clone to `/tmp/inkuno-release`, verified HEAD == `a92250e` == `origin/main`, on branch `main`.

**4. Dry run** — `DRY_RUN=1 scripts/release.sh 0.0.1` needed one env fix: this machine's active toolchain is CommandLineTools (`xcrun metal` missing), but `Xcode.app` exists, so `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer` resolved it (no sudo needed). Plan confirmed; tests ran: 464 passed / 11 failed.

**5. Real run** — `scripts/release.sh 0.0.1` (real, authorized) **failed at the local `cargo test --locked -q` gate, exit 101**: 467 passed, **8 failed**, 18 ignored. Deterministic failures, reproduced across CI + 2 local runs:
- `shell::tests::end_to_end::end_to_end`
- `shell::tests::window::{bottom_band_keeps_the_text_clear, clear_at_a_glance, rail_groups_keep_their_order_and_room, small_targets_are_24_px, the_window_can_always_be_grabbed_at_the_top, update_banner_stays_clear_of_the_formatting_bar, window_buttons_leave_the_header_and_the_title_clear}` (e.g. `window_buttons…: 860: the text starts at 56px, the window buttons end at 57px`)
- (Dry run additionally flaked on `french_says_vous`, `layers_only_depend_downwards`, `shapes_come_from_the_theme` — all passed in the real run.)

## Blocker (exact)
`scripts/release.sh` runs `cargo test --locked -q` locally after the version bump and aborts (`set -e`) before commit/tag/push on failure. With 8 red layout/e2e asserts, the release cannot proceed via the documented script path, and I did not bypass the gate.

## Verified no side effects
- No local or remote `v0.0.1` tag; `origin/main` still `a92250e`; working tree clean (rollback worked).
- `gh release list` shows only the pre-existing `nightly` pre-release — no draft created, no `release-native.yml` dispatched.
- Post-merge main CI `42576431632` was still in progress; main Release-checks and Docs runs on the merge commit already show failure (pre-existing publication/Pages reds).

## Follow-up for owner
- Blocker note posted on PR #3: https://github.com/kolisachint/inkuno/pull/3#issuecomment-6734576485
- To unblock: fix the 8 deterministic window/e2e asserts forward on `main`, then re-run `scripts/release.sh 0.0.1` from a fresh checkout — or make an explicit decision about the release gate. Cleanup reminder: `agent/inkuno-0.0.1` branch still exists; leave/delete per owner call.
